notes.title: New US & Asia Servers! + Numerous Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce that our new servers in the US and Asia are now live, offering improved connectivity and stability. Additionally, many files previously required to be downloaded at the start are now pre-loaded directly into the build, streamlining your gaming experience.

Please take note of the following improvements from our last updates, which were not previously documented:
[list]
[*][b]Catch Rate Adjustment:[/b] Based on feedback, the initial catch rate was too challenging. It has been made easier, allowing for more successful catches with fewer attempts.[/*]
[*][b]Evocube Classic Price Reduction:[/b] The price for our primary catching device, the Evocube Classic, has been reduced from 250 to 150 Duel Coins.[/*]
[*][b]Evo Essence Reward:[/b] Releasing an Evo from the Storage menu now grants 1 Evo Essence.[/*]
[*][b]Evo Balancing:[/b] We've upgraded several Evos and nerfed some overpowered ones.[/*]
[*][b]Crash Report System:[/b] A new system for reporting game errors has been implemented, allowing us to quickly identify and rectify issues.[/*]
[*][b]Other Fixes:[/b] Various bugs have been addressed, including random crashes.[/*]
[/list]

Thank you for your support and feedback which help us improve the game continuously. Enjoy the enhanced gameplay and keep dueling!
